heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: How do you test across so many devices?
items.answer: We test on a representative range of real devices and tune graphics settings per device tier.

items.question: Can you integrate ads?
items.answer: Yes. We integrate leading ad networks and design placements that respect the player.

items.question: Do you support post-launch updates?
items.answer: Yes. We ship bug fixes, new levels and events.

items.question: How long does android game development take?
items.answer: A simple casual game takes about 2 to 3 months, while a polished 3D or multiplayer game usually takes 6 months or more.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
